    A rigid map system on a regular uncountable cardinal #

    For a well-order α of regular uncountable type, the set Dec α of nonempty finite strictly decreasing sequences (stored as increasing lists, so the head is the last entry) carries a rigid map system (Rigid.isRigidSys_regSys). The maps are: dropping the last entry, the ladder coordinates [δ] ↦ [η_δ(m)], a surjection from a cofinal set B of stationary ladder values, a constant map and an injection into the singletons. This is a linear form of Shelah's Theorem 2.1 (Israel J. Math. 18, 1974); see the thread note 2026-10-29-202837-rigid-structures-proof.md.
